shortDescription: Three z-levels (sky/surface/basement) in ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. V1 deleted; ~6.3k LOC total. Publishes as a new mod, disconnected from the old Workshop upload.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 (42.6k LOC / 156 files) has been **DELETED**. Everything below describes the only architecture that exists now.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`, so the column behaves as one big map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. THE ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`. Bands stack along **+z**, each a contiguous `CellIndices` range. `band = surfaceBand + level`; bottom-to-top = basement / surface / sky. An impassable, permanently-fogged **gutter** separates bands.

**`Slot` is rounded up to a multiple of 64** (250-high band → slot 256, gutter 6). Load-bearing: RimWorld terrain shaders sample from WORLD POSITION, so a non-aligned vertical offset makes identical terrain render with a different texture phase in the see-below view.

### The one insight everything rests on
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Two spatially distant regions that share a `RegionLink` are adjacent as far as RimWorld is concerned. Both ends are `RegionType.Portal` (the stair is a `Building_Door` subclass), and `Portal` fails `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom`, so the link **conducts connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum**.

`Reachability.CanReach` is managed region-BFS, so it works unpatched — and that transitively fixes `ClosestThingReachable`, `RegionTraverser`, storage search and **every `WorkGiver_Scanner`**.

**PROVEN in-game:** a colonist hauled steel out of a SEALED chamber joined only by a synthetic `RegionLink`, with zero hauling code written.

### The dividing line
| Class | Outcome |
|---|---|
| **Graph / logic** — reachability, storage, work scanning, hauling, needs, reservations | **FREE** |
| **Geometry / presentation** — LOS, range, targeting, path lines, ghosts, projectiles, labels, selection | **NOT free.** Every 2D-cell-space computation must be told |

Each geometry surface is corrected **at its own draw/compute site**. Do NOT patch `Thing.DrawPos` globally — the see-below renderer prints below things at real positions then translates emitted vertices, so a pre-localized DrawPos double-shifts. (That trap was V1's `DrawPosOffsetPatcher`, now deleted.)

### Hard 1.6 constraints
- The pathfinder is **jobified** (`PathFinderJob` : `IJob` over `NativeArray`; `PathGridJob` : `IJobParallelFor`). A* neighbour expansion is **not patchable**. All custom traversal lives at `Pawn_PathFollower`. `PathRequest.ValidateInt` gates on `pawn.CanReach`.
- `PathFinder` has **no `FindPath` method**; the managed surface is `FindPathNow` + `PathFinderTick`. Harmony cannot see inside the Burst job, so **pathfinding cost is only measurable end-to-end (wall clock)**.

---

# 2. WHAT'S BUILT (`Source/`, ~6.3k LOC)

**Core (shared tier, `Source/Core/`)** — `ABMod`/`ABLog` · `ABGuard` (per-subsystem kill switches; a failure disables one subsystem silently, so check guard state when a feature "just stops") · `ABDefOf` (3 terrain defs only) · `ABSettings` (9 fields, V2-only) · `ABGameComp` · `ABGameHooks` · `ABBlame` · `ABPawnCooldown` · `HarmonyBoot`.

**Core model** — `ABBandMap` (persisted layout, slot alignment) · `ABBands` (allocation-free CWT-cached facade) · **`ABWormhole`** (synthetic RegionLink + re-arm postfix on `RegionAndRoomUpdater.TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`) · `ABWormholePather` (StartPath segmentation + per-tick position sweep).

**Generation** — `ABBandedGeneration` · `ABSkyBandGen` (solid-mass projection, 8-way BFS edge distance, meadow-Perlin classification) · `ABRockOreGen` (rock/ore scatter, rescued from V1) · `ABMapSizeLimit` (200×200 cap).

**Renderer** — `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2` (terrain + things + air mask + fog) · `SectionLayer_ABBelowLighting` · `SectionLayer_ABBelowShadows` · `ABBelowDynamicDraw`.

**Interaction** — `Building_ABStairs2` (+ ladders) · `Building_ABAnchor` · `ABStairsOrders` · `ABBelowClickThrough` · `ABBelowMultiSelect` · `ABBelowOverlays` · `ABBelowSelectionDraw` · `ABBandView` · `ABBandJump` · `ABBandInput` · `ABUIGeometry`.

**Combat** — `ABCombatV2` · `ABCombatGeometry` · `ABCombatAcquisition`.

**Debug** — `ABV2Debug` · `ABDevTools.V2` / `.V2Spike` / `.V2Support`.

---

# 3. MEASURED PERFORMANCE (Modern Dev Suite, 2000-frame windows)

Profiling is done with **Modern Dev Suite** (`astryl.ModernDevSuite`), driven over its loopback API at `127.0.0.1:8787` (`POST /api/v1/commands` with `startRun`/`stopRun`; runs land in `<savedata>/ModernDevSuite/Runs/*.json`). The **Run full sweep** button in its Live tab is the only step that needs a human.

### Fixed this pass
1. **Forbidden-overlay postfix: 1.406 ms/frame → thing-iteration.** `Patch_OverlayDrawer_ABBelowForbidden` swept EVERY cell of the translated view rect doing a `ThingsListAtFast` per open-air cell — **74% of the mod's entire profiled cost**, worst exactly when looking down from the sky at open surface. Now reads vanilla's own `OverlayDrawer.overlayHandles` dict (which `DrawAllOverlays` never clears), matching the pattern its sibling `Patch_ThingOverlays_ABBelow` already used.
2. **Wormhole re-arm: 4,763,123 calls (~2381/frame) → gated.** The postfix re-armed on every `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` call, but that method early-outs on `!AnyDirty`. Now a prefix samples vanilla's public `AnythingToRebuild` (`AnyDirty || !initialized`) into `__state`; sampled in the PREFIX because the method calls `SetAllClean()` before returning. Deliberately permissive — over-arming is wasteful, under-arming silently severs every wormhole.
3. **V1 deleted** — it was never inert, only idle. Its patches stayed applied and executing: `WorldObject.get_Tile` (2.6M calls), `Map.get_IsPlayerHome` (532k), `ThinkNode_JobGiver.TryIssueJobPackage` (111k), `PawnRenderer.ParallelGetPreRenderResults`, and `Thing.get_DrawPos` — the exact patch the architecture forbids.

### Measured NOT to be a problem
`SectionLayer_ABBelowV2.Regenerate` — the layer that prints all below terrain, edge fades and things — costs **1.72 ms per 2000 frames across 179 calls (~0.9 µs/call)**. Stripping below-layers from basement/gutter sections is a **memory-only** win; it was dropped as a frame-time optimization.

### Measurement traps (both cost a wrong conclusion)
- **Nested instrumentation inflates outer timings.** A run arming 227 methods reported `ABBelowV2.Regenerate` 154× higher than a run arming 29. Never compare absolute layer costs across runs with different armed-target counts: use a low-target run for layer cost, a high-target run for attribution.
- **Vanilla's `SectionLayer_LightingOverlay` still regenerates on banded maps** (~3.92 ms/2000 frames) even though we force its `Visible` false — `Section.TryUpdate` does NOT check `Visible`; only `RegenerateDirtyLayers` does. Suppressing at the getter stops the draw, not the bake. **Open fix:** prefix its `Regenerate` to no-op on banded maps.

### Throttling: already free
`Section.TryUpdate(view)` does **not** regenerate dirty layers for sections outside the camera view — it latches `anyLayerDirty`, clears `dirtyFlags`, and defers regeneration to `DrawSection()` when the section comes into view. So bands you aren't looking at already cost ~zero mesh regeneration, and "catch up the instant you switch view" is vanilla behaviour. Do NOT build a band-visibility throttle; it would need a global "current band" latch, the anti-pattern that made V1 unmaintainable.

---

# 4. ENGINE LESSONS

1. **`dontRender` terrain silently suppresses shadows** (`SectionLayer_Terrain` swaps in `MatBases.ShadowMask`).
2. **Terrain shaders use world-position UVs.** Build terrain quads by hand.
3. **Never depend on `PatherArrived` firing at an exact cell.** Use a per-tick position sweep.
4. **Never `Clear` a transit record on same-band `StartPath`** — segmentation rewrites the destination into the pawn's own band. Records expire on a 4000-tick timeout.
5. **Aiming uses `Face`/`FaceCell`, not `FaceTarget`.**
6. **Vanilla emits THREE sun-shadow skirts** (west/east/south) with DIFFERENT windings, no north skirt.
7. **Lighting: two complementary bakes cause vignetting** — one bake with the glow source substituted per cell is correct.
8. Misc: `menuHidden` doesn't exist on ThingDef · geysers are `destroyable=false` (DeSpawn, don't Destroy) · `GenStep_Fog` fogs the whole map · `GenRadial` caps at ~79.8 · `MapDrawLayer.map` is private, use `SectionLayer.section`.

**PROCESS LESSON: measuring beat reasoning every single time.** Pre-measurement the suspected hot spots were the see-below layers; measurement showed they were nearly free and the cost was an overlay sweep and a re-arm postfix nobody suspected. Also: **emit ONE self-contained log message per event** — separate `Log` calls from one helper share a stack signature and get folded by the monitor.

---

# 5. OPEN WORK

### Bugs
- **COMBAT (highest priority).** Cross-band shots: pawn "fires straight down", projectile doesn't hit. **Two separate problems**, previously conflated: (a) the *visual* — `ABBelowDynamicDraw` iterates `map.mapPawns.AllPawnsSpawned` only, so projectiles in the band below are confirmed never drawn from above; (b) the *hit* — impact resolves in `Projectile.Tick`/`ImpactSomething`, independent of draw, so fixing (a) will make it look right while still missing.
- **Colonists sometimes don't spawn on generation.** Strict → relaxed → seed passes; unconfirmed.

### Perf
- **`PathGridJob` is `IJobParallelFor` over ALL cells** — still the one place V2 may be measurably worse, and **still unmeasured**. MDS's `ai.pathfind` scenario is now band-safe (samples standable cells, divides by effective iterations), so the next sweep should finally answer it.
- No-op vanilla's `SectionLayer_LightingOverlay.Regenerate` on banded maps (~3.92 ms/2000 frames wasted).
- Map generation ~3× slower (vanilla generates over the whole tall map, then bands are carved).
- Compat audit not started: MissileGirl, PrePatcher, Faster Game Loading, Performance Esmolas, Performance Optimizer, Clean Pathfinding 2, Kingfisher.

### Deferred features
- **Transplant** (generate a normal map at full fidelity, move it into band 1) — fixes the coastline caveat (**use inland tiles for now**), save migration, true-lazy banding.
- Turret cross-band targeting · drafted move ghost · per-band biome consumers · sky richness · cliff-face wall facades.

### `ABBandEnv` — read before touching biomes
V2's one genuine regression vs V1: `Map.Biome` is get-only and derived from the world tile, so per-band biome must be fed to each consumer explicitly (already done for `WildPlantSpawner` density, `GenTemperature`, and two `CellFinder` edge-cell patches). **A contextual `map.Biome` getter driven by an ambient "current cell" latch is DELIBERATELY REJECTED** — it would catch third-party code for free and is exactly the lying-to-vanilla-behind-a-global-latch pattern that made V1 unmaintainable.

---

# 6. PUBLISHING STATE

Disconnected from the original upload: `About/PublishedFileId.txt` deleted, renamed **"As above, So below II"**, packageId **`astryl.AsAboveSoBelow2`**, `incompatibleWith` the original `astryl.AsAboveSoBelow`.

**⚠ BEFORE PUBLISHING:**
1. **`About.xml` `<description>` is still V1's** and makes **false functional claims** — it promises elevators, vertical conduit/water/duct/chem shafts, psycast cross-level targeting, caravans, Hospitality guest tours, trader airships and "zero recurring cost until you build a level", none of which exist in V2. This is a store-page accuracy problem, not a copy edit. User-owned text.
2. `About/known-issues.json` is V1's.
3. `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/HELICOPTER_VIEW.md` describe V1.

## Settings
Map size capped at **200×200**; a toggle unlocks it behind a bold red performance warning. Enforced twice — chooser AND generation.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true` always. Companions: **`astryl.ModernDevSuite`** (+ `astryl.ModernDevTools`); NOT Melee Animation. Palette pins get culled for Playing-gated debug actions — use the Debug Actions menu. **Banding happens at generation ⇒ needs a NEW colony** (quicktest qualifies). Map gen is ~3× slower — expected, not a hang. **Use inland tiles until transplant lands.**
